title: On the Graph Corresponding to Center of Distances of Metric Space
summary: The center of distances $C(Y)$ of a metric space $(Y,ρ)$ is the set of all $t\geq 0$ for which the equation $ρ(y,p)=t $ has a solution for each point $p\in Y$. We say that a simple graph $CG_Y$ is the central graph of a metric space $(Y,ρ)$ if $Y$ is the vertex set of $CG_Y$ and distinct vertices $x,y\in Y$ are adjacent if and only if $ρ(x,y)\in C(Y)$.
